name: Checkbox
description: A standard checkbox component allowing users to select one or more options. Supports checked, unchecked, and indeterminate states.
usage: Use for boolean selections or when multiple items can be chosen from a list.
Controlled with `checked` (boolean or 'indeterminate') and `onChange(checked)`, value first; or uncontrolled with `defaultChecked` (onChange still fires).
Provide a `label`, or pass `aria-label`, or label it from outside with `<label htmlFor={id}>`.
The `indeterminate` state visually indicates that a sub-selection is partially checked (e.g., in a tree structure). A click on it calls onChange(true); a controlled parent decides what follows.
Sizes: 'sm' | 'md' (default) | 'lg'; the label takes the scale's type (sm: type-label-sm; md, lg: type-label).
examples:
```tsx
// Disabled Checkbox
<Checkbox id="disabled-check" checked={true} onChange={() => {}} label="Cannot change" disabled />
```

```tsx
// Indeterminate Checkbox
<Checkbox id="select-all" checked={'indeterminate'} onChange={handleSelectAllChange} label="Select some items" />
```

```tsx
// Different Sizes
<Checkbox id="small-check" checked={val} onChange={setVal} label="Small" size="sm" />
<Checkbox id="medium-check" checked={val} onChange={setVal} label="Medium" size="md" />
<Checkbox id="large-check" checked={val} onChange={setVal} label="Large" size="lg" />
```

```tsx
// Uncontrolled, named without a visible label
<Checkbox defaultChecked aria-label="Select row" onChange={save} />
```
design: Use checkboxes for lists where users can select zero, one, or multiple items.
Use the indeterminate state primarily for parent checkboxes that reflect the state of child checkboxes.
Focus ring: keyboard only (focus-visible), 2px var(--color-border-focus) with offset
accessibility: Uses a visually hidden native `<input type="checkbox">` for semantics and keyboard navigation (Space toggles it).
Keyboard focus ring on the box (peer-focus-visible, --color-border-focus with offset).
Disabled sets the native disabled attribute; the root uses `opacity-50` and `cursor-not-allowed`.
The `label` prop is associated with the input via the `htmlFor` attribute; the id is generated when left out.
Indeterminate sets the input's indeterminate property, so assistive technology announces it as mixed.
The custom visual element uses `aria-hidden="true"` as the native input provides the semantics.

props.name: id
props.description: The input's id; generated with useId() when left out

props.name: checked
props.description: Controlled: true, false or 'indeterminate'. Leave out for uncontrolled

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new boolean state, value first, in both modes. A click on an indeterminate box calls it with true

props.name: label
props.description: The content to display next to the checkbox, typically a string or JSX.

props.name: disabled
props.description: If true, the checkbox will be visually disabled and non-interactive.

props.name: size
props.description: Specifies the size of the checkbox visual element.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root label (merged with cn)

props.name: ...rest
props.description: Every other prop (name, value, aria-*, data-*, onBlur…) goes to the input
